Shape measurements show where width is: Ma'aunin sifa yana nuna inda faɗin yake
Posture decides where wrinkles appear: Matsayi yana yanke shawarar inda wrinkles suka bayyana
Two women with a 100 cm bust can need co: Mata biyu masu tsayin 100 cm na iya buƙatar nau'i daban-daban. Ma'aunin siffa yana bayyana inda kowane jiki ya ɗauki faɗinsa.
Posture matters too. One client leans ba: Matsayi ma yana da mahimmanci. Wani abokin ciniki ya jingina baya, wani ya zagaye kafadunta. Waɗannan sun yanke shawarar inda za su bayyana wrinkles.
And one wrong number can ruin a gown, so: Kuma lamba ɗaya ba daidai ba na iya lalata rigar, don haka muna gina bincike a cikin abubuwan yau da kullun.
Large difference: draft the frame from h: Bambanci babba: zayyana firam daga babban bust, sannan ƙara fashe.
High bust 92 cm, full bust 104 cm: Babban tsayi 92 cm, cikakken tsayi 104 cm
Frame is closer to a 92 cm body: Frame ya fi kusa da jiki 92 cm
Bust span 20 cm: 10 cm each side: Tsawon tsutsa 20 cm: 10 cm kowane gefe
Bust depth 27 cm sets dart height: Zurfin ƙirji 27 cm yana saita tsayin dart
Take the high bust high under the arms,: Ɗauki babban tsayi mai tsayi a ƙarƙashin makamai, da cikakken fashe sama da cikakken ɓangaren. Ka ce ta saka rigar mama da za ta saka da rigar.
For example, Ngozi in Port Harcourt meas: Misali, Ngozi a Fatakwal tana auna abokin ciniki: tsayi mai tsayi 92 cm, cikakken tsagi 104 cm.
So her shoulders and back are closer to: Don haka kafadunta da bayanta sun fi kusa da jiki na 92 cm. Zanewa daga 104 zai sa layin wuya ya yi faɗi da yawa da gape ɗin hannu.
The bust span of 20 cm means each bust p: Tsawon tsayin daka na 20 cm yana nufin kowane bust yana zama 10 cm daga gaban tsakiya.
And the bust depth of 27 cm sets how low: Kuma zurfin bust na 27 cm yana saita yadda ƙananan bust ɗin ke zaune, don haka darts da gimbiya seams suna nufin wurin da ya dace.
Ngozi drafts the frame from the smaller: Ngozi tana zana firam ɗin daga ƙaramar lamba kuma tana ƙara faɗin bust tare da daidaitawar tsatsa. Toile dinta na farko yana zaune daidai.
Sway back: shorten back waist length: Juya baya: rage tsawon kugu na baya
Rounded upper back: more back length: Zagaye babba baya: ƙarin tsayin baya
Full tummy: extra front length and width: Cikakken ciki: ƙarin tsayin gaba da faɗin
Prominent seat: deeper back darts, lengt: Babban wurin zama: zurfin darts na baya, tsayi
Uneven shoulders: adjust one side: Kafadu marasa daidaituwa: daidaita gefe ɗaya
Ask her to stand naturally, and look fro: Ka tambaye ta ta tsaya a zahiri, kuma ta duba daga gaba, gefe da baya.
A deep hollow at the lower back is a swa: Wani rami mai zurfi a ƙasan baya shine jujjuyawar baya. Yana ba da folds sama da kugu na baya, don haka rage tsawon kugu na baya.
A rounded upper back makes the back pull: Babban baya mai zagaye yana sa baya ya ja sama, don haka yana buƙatar ƙarin tsayin baya da faɗin.
A full tummy makes the front hem rise. T: Cikakkun ciki na sa gaban gaba ya tashi. Gaba yana buƙatar ƙarin tsayi da faɗi.
A prominent seat makes the back skirt ri: Fitaccen wurin zama yana sa siket na baya ya hau sama, don haka zurfafa darts na baya kuma ƙara tsayi.
Use neutral words. Say, your back has a: Yi amfani da kalmomin tsaka tsaki. Ka ce, bayan ku yana da lanƙwasa kyakkyawa, don haka zan gajarta kugu na baya. Kada ka sa ta ji an yi mata hukunci.

Never take them undressed, and never pos: Kada ku taɓa ɗaukar su ba tare da sutura ba, kuma kada ku buga su ko aika su ga kowa. Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023 ta tsara ayyuka ga duk wanda ke sarrafa bayanan sirri.

For example, Tola in Lagos has 60 past c: Misali, Tola a Legas yana da katunan abokin ciniki 60 da suka wuce. Yawancin faɗuwa tsakanin 92 zuwa 112 cm faɗuwa, tare da babban gungu a kusa da 100 zuwa 104 cm.
She makes that her base size, M, because: Ta sanya girman gindinta, M, saboda kurakurai masu dacewa sun fi ƙanƙanta kusa da tsakiya.
With a 5 cm interval she gets S, M, L an: Tare da tazara na 5 cm tana samun S, M, L da XL, kuma tana saita jeri na hip daga bayanan nata.

Cross-checks catch errors. Take bust, wa: Canje-canje yana kama kurakurai. Ɗauki nono, kugu da hips sau biyu. Idan karatun ya bambanta da fiye da 1 cm, ɗauki na uku. Sai a auna rigar da take so.

Chioma re-measures with the client's fee: Chioma ta sake aunawa tare da ƙafafun abokin ciniki tare kuma ya sami 98 cm. Tef ɗin ya tsoma a baya.

Change a tested block on paper: Canja shingen da aka gwada akan takarda
Every new style keeps that fit: Kowane sabon salo yana kiyaye wannan dacewa
Flat-pattern manipulation means changing: Gyaran tsari yana nufin canza shingen da aka gwada akan takarda don yin sabon salo. Saboda toshe ya riga ya dace, kowane sabon salo yana kiyaye wannan dacewa a wuyansa, kafada, bust da kugu.
Always work on a copy, never the master,: Koyaushe yi aiki akan kwafi, ba maigida ba, tare da layin hatsi, bust point da alamar ƙira.
After every change, true the new seams:: Bayan kowane canje-canje, gaskiya ne sabon seams: duba cewa gefuna da aka dinka tare tsawonsu ɗaya ne. Gyara shi a kan takarda, ba a kan masana'anta ba.
With slash and spread, you cut lines on: Tare da slash da yadawa, kuna yanke layi akan kwafi kuma buɗe su don ƙara faɗin. Don siket mai walƙiya, yanke daga maƙarƙashiya zuwa ƙwarya kuma rufe dart. Dart ya zama mai walƙiya a gindi.
With pivot, you hold the paper down with: Tare da pivot, kuna riƙe takarda ƙasa tare da awl akan wurin bust ɗin kuma juya toshe don rufe dart. Dukansu suna ba da sakamako iri ɗaya.
Soft gathers: about 1.5 times. Heavy gat: Taruwa mai laushi: kusan sau 1.5. Taro mai yawa: kusan sau 2.
Front waist on the quarter: 20 cm: Ƙimar gaba a kan kwata: 20 cm

Slash into 5 strips, spread 2.5 cm each: Yanke cikin tube 5, yada 2.5 cm kowane
For example, Zainab in Abuja makes a yok: Misali, zainab a Abuja ta yi wankin rigar karkiya tare da tattaro peplum na saitin ankara. Kugunta na gaba akan ƙirar kwata shine 20 cm.
She wants 1.5 times fullness, so the top: Tana son cikawa sau 1.5, don haka saman gefen peplum yana buƙatar 30 cm.
Ta zana rectangle 20 cm da 15 cm.
She slashes it into five strips and spre: Ta yanke shi zuwa sassa biyar kuma ta yada kowane rata da 2.5 cm a saman, yana ba da 30 cm.
She marks notches and tests the peplum i: Ta yi alamar notches da gwada peplum a calico kafin ta yanke ankara.
Chiffon gathers beautifully at 2 times,: Chiffon yana taruwa da kyau sau 2, amma aso-oke mai tauri zai yi kama da girma. Gwada a kan tsiri na masana'anta da farko.
Waist 6 cm too big, bust and hip fine: Tsayin 6 cm yayi girma sosai, bust da hip lafiya
Blend back about 10 cm above and below: Haɗa baya kamar 10 cm sama da ƙasa
Re-true seams; change lining too: Sake kabu na gaskiya; canza launi kuma
A princess seam is a full seam over the: Gimbiya dinki cikakken dinki ne akan bust, don haka kowane panel ana iya siffata shi da kansa. Misali, Efe a birnin Benin yana yin rigar rigar lace. A ɗakin bayan gida, kugu yana da girman 6 cm tsayi sosai.
The gown has front and back princess sea: Rigar tana da rigar gimbiya gaba da bayanta tare da kabu biyu na gefe. Wato kabu shida, da gefuna goma sha biyu.
So she takes 0.5 cm from each edge at th: Don haka ta ɗauki 0.5 cm daga kowane gefen a kugu, ba duka daga gefen gefen ba.
She blends back to the original line abo: Ta haɗu da baya zuwa asalin layin kamar 10 cm sama da ƙasa.
Then she re-trues every seam pair and ch: Sa'an nan kuma ta sake tabbatar da kowane nau'i na sutura kuma ta canza sutura kuma. Hatsi ya tsaya tsaye kuma yadin da aka saka ya tsaya daidai.
Draft the sleeve from the armhole: Zana hannun riga daga ramin hannu
Sew one calico test sleeve before cuttin: Dinka rigar gwajin calico guda ɗaya kafin yanke yadin da aka saka.
Add about 3 cm cap ease: about 48.5 cm: Ƙara kusan 3 cm sauƙi sauƙi: game da 48.5 cm
Bicep too narrow? Lower the cap 1 cm: Bicep yayi kunkuntar? Rage hular 1 cm
Cap curve 49.5 cm? Flatten near crown: Tsawon kafa 49.5 cm? Kwance kusa da rawani
The sleeve cap must match the armhole, p: Dole ne hular hannun riga ta yi daidai da ramin hannu, da ƙaramin ƙaramar da aka tsara wanda ake kira sauƙin hula. Misali, Adaeze a Owerri yana auna hujin hannu na gaba mai tsawon cm 22 da bayansa na 23.5 cm. Jimlar, 45.5 cm.
For crepe she wants about 3 cm of cap ea: Don crepe tana son kusan 3 cm na sauƙi mai sauƙi, don haka madaidaicin hula yakamata ya zama kusan 48.5 cm.
Her first draft gave a bicep of 31 cm, l: Daftarin ta na farko ya ba da bicep na 31 cm, ƙasa da hannun abokin ciniki 32 cm. Ƙarƙashin hula yana yin babban hannun riga, don haka ta rage shi da 1 cm. Bicep ya zama kusan 34 cm.
The new cap curve measures 49.5 cm, too: Sabuwar lanƙwan hula tana da 49.5 cm, tsayi da yawa. Ta fad'a dan kusa da taji.
Now it is 48.6 cm. Remember, a high cap: Yanzu yana da 48.6 cm. Ka tuna, babban hula yana da kyau amma yana iyakance ɗaga hannu. Ƙarƙashin hula yana ba da ƙarin motsi.
Sleeves are cheap to test and expensive: Hannun hannu suna da arha don gwadawa kuma suna da tsada don yin kuskure a cikin yadin da aka saka. Dinka hannun rigar calico a cikin bandaki sannan a duba ya rataye ba tare da murzawa ba.
Three collars from the neckline: Abun wuya uku daga layin wuya

For a Peter Pan collar, overlap the shou: Don abin wuya na Peter Pan, haɗa kafadu da 1 zuwa 2 cm a ƙarshen hannun hannu. Wannan yana ba da ɗan birgima wanda ke ɓoye kabu.
For a shirt collar, the stand curves upw: Don abin wuyan riga, tsayawar yana lanƙwasa zuwa sama amma abin wuya yana lanƙwasa ƙasa a gaba, kuma abin wuya yana da zurfin 1 zuwa 1.5 cm a baya.
Staystitch the neckline right after cutt: Tsaya wuyan wuyan daidai bayan yanke, don haka baya shimfiɗawa.
Manipulate a copy, never the master: Yi amfani da kwafi, ba maigida ba
A closed dart can become yoke, gathers o: Ƙarfin da aka rufe zai iya zama karkiya, taruwa ko walƙiya

The client wants a closer sleeve, which: Abokin ciniki yana son hannun riga mafi kusa, wanda zai iya ja da yage a ƙarƙashin hannu. Don haka Yetunde yana ƙara gusset-yanke 10 cm da 10 cm a kowace ƙarƙashin hannu.

The centre panel is 2 times 138, plus 3: Ƙungiyar tsakiya shine sau 2 138, da 3 cm tsayi a kowane ƙarshen. Wannan shine 282 cm. Ƙungiyoyin gefe sun dace da gefe a cikin wani tsayin daka.

This module brings everything together a: Wannan tsarin yana haɗa komai tare a matakin da abokan ciniki ke biyan mafi yawa. Toile shine kayan gwaji da aka dinka daga calico mai nauyin nauyi zuwa masana'anta na ƙarshe. Ainihin dacewa yana faruwa a can, kuma gyare-gyaren suna tafiya akan tsarin.
Then you will build quality checks into: Sa'an nan za ku gina ingancin cak a kowane mataki, da kuma gudanar da aikin abokin ciniki tare da rubutaccen umarni da farashin da za ku iya bayyanawa.

Ask her to sit, reach and walk: Ka ce ta zauna, ta kai ta tafiya
Fit from the top down, because a change: Fit daga sama zuwa ƙasa, saboda canji a kafada yana rinjayar duk abin da ke ƙasa. Gyara babbar matsalar farko. Layukan ja da baya su ne wrinkles daga ja da masana'anta ko tattarawa, kuma suna nuni zuwa ga matsalar.
Diagonal pulls from the bust towards the: Diagonal ja daga bust ɗin zuwa gefen kabu yana nufin rashin isashen ɗaki sama da bust ɗin.
Horizontal folds just above the back wai: Juyawa a kwance sama da kugu na baya yana nufin bayan ya yi tsayi da yawa don jujjuya baya.
Diagonal folds from the neck towards the: Ninkewar diagonal daga wuya zuwa ga hannun hannu yana nufin gangaren kafadunta fiye da tsarin.
Before you finish, ask her to sit, raise: Kafin ka gama, ka ce mata ta zauna, ta ɗaga hannuwanta, ta kai gaba ta yi tafiya. Dole ne riguna na Owambe su tsira daga rawa. Daidaita a cikin keɓaɓɓen kusurwa, allon fuska, kuma tambaya kafin a taɓa kusa da ƙirjin ko kwatangwalo.

The bust pulls remain. Unpicked at the s: Janye fatun ya rage. Ba a tsince su a gefen kabu ba, maɓuɓɓugan bayan gida suna buɗe kusan 2 cm kowane gefe. Don haka ta shimfiɗa gefen gaban panel 2 cm a matakin bust kuma ta ƙara tsayin da ya dace.
At the back she pinches out about 1.5 cm: A baya ta fizge kusan 1.5 cm a tsakiyar gindin baya, ba ta da wani abu a kabu na gefe, sannan ta ninke waccan gunkin akan ƙirar.
The client's bicep is 36 cm, and the sle: Bicep na abokin ciniki shine 36 cm, kuma hannun riga kawai 34. Tare da 3 cm na sauƙi tana buƙatar 39, don haka ta shimfiɗa hannun riga 5 cm.
The new cap now has 5 cm of ease, too mu: Sabuwar hular yanzu tana da 5 cm na sauƙi, da yawa, don haka ta balla shi zuwa 3 cm.
Changes interact, so she sews a second q: Canje-canje suna hulɗa, don haka ta dinka wando mai sauri na biyu. Ya fi rahusa fiye da gyaran yadin da aka saka, kuma ya dace ba tare da layukan ja ba.
